relevance_note: Microbiome study of genetically defined HA20 patients ("Stool samples were obtained from 16 patients with HA20"; "A20, which is encoded by the tumor necrosis factor alpha-induced protein 3 (TNFAIP3) gene"); only three patients (P4, P9, P21) and one sibling (P22-sib) are described individually, and no TNFAIP3 variant is printed for anyone.
method_note: Read the full Markdown by hand; no table was transcribed by script (Tables 1 and 2 are aggregate statistics only). The per-patient Supplementary Table 1 is not in the Markdown, so individual rows come only from the Discussion sentence naming P4, P9 and P21 (labels follow the numbering of Kadowaki et al., 2018) and the Results sentence naming P22-sib. Ages for P4/P9/P21 were split from '(4, 1, and 3 years old, respectively)' and recorded as age at last evaluation (they appear to be ages at sample collection; not stated explicitly). Country 'Japan' for P4/P9/P21 combines two statements (Kadowaki 2018 cohort 'from nine families in Japan' + these patients 'previously described ... (Kadowaki et al., 2018)'). Severity classes (moderate/severe) are the paper's own scale and were recorded as features; the example symptoms in the class definitions were NOT used to fill the checklist. Variants table empty: no variant, cDNA, protein or zygosity is printed for any person; TNFAIP3 status rests only on the HA20 diagnosis. Not used: 'Nobody but an excluded younger brother (P22-sib) has food allergies' was not used to exclude food allergy for others because the group is not named. Cohort counts (e.g. 'Eleven of 13 patients ... presented with stomatitis') name no individuals and exclude no one. Internal inconsistencies noted: Tables 1-2 give '5 (28%)' for severity and immunosuppressants although 5/13 is 38%; participants are '18 patients' from 'nine families' but samples came from 16 patients in 'eight corresponding families'; P22-sib's HA20/genetic status is not stated (possibly 'a sibling whose genetic information is unknown', not confirmed).
